newsitem.title: YEMEN: Yemen frees five abducted Dutch tourists - official.
newsitem.headline: Yemen frees five abducted Dutch tourists - official.

text.p: Yemeni authorities have freed five Dutch tourists who were briefly abducted by tribesmen while touring the country, a senior security official said on Friday.

The tourists were held for three hours by armed tribesmen while touring the governorate of Saada, 240-km (150-miles) north of the capital Sanaa on Thursday in a car owned by a local tour operator, he added.
The official, who requested anonymity, declined further comment on what is believed to be the shortest abduction of foreigners by Yemeni tribes.
In recent years, tribes in Yemen with grievances against the government or foreign oil firms kidnapped tourists or foreigners as bargaining chips.
At least three diplomats, an American, a Saudi and a Frenchman, have been among the kidnapped victims.

The Frenchman was released in October after being held for a week by a local tribe seeking government compensation for losses to homes, farms, water pumps and wells by floods that killed 65 people in June.
